title: Rain Ripples
subtitle: Colorful raindrops & expanding water ripples
description: Raindrops fall onto a dark water surface and burst into expanding rainbow rings. A lattice of dots lights up in shifting hues as each ripple passes through it, with additive glow bands tracing every wavefront. Inspired by Okazz's #p5js raindrop study.

parameters.label: Rainfall
parameters.description: Number of raindrops striking the surface per second

parameters.label: Ripple Speed
parameters.description: How fast each ripple ring expands outward

parameters.label: Ripple Reach
parameters.description: Maximum radius a ripple travels before fading out

parameters.label: Dot Spacing
parameters.description: Spacing of the dot lattice (smaller = denser field)

parameters.label: Hue Shift
parameters.description: Rotates the entire rainbow palette around the color wheel
